text: Harvest Drop
The harvest came in fat and early, no notes.
Pottery Core Unlocked
Clay bends to your patience, it's giving craft. Sealed pots keep the harvest alive through the lean months, and the surplus is actually staying, no cap. Food +1/tick, stone +0.5/tick for {dur}.
Metal Hits Different
This forge runs hotter than any fire before it, and the smiths are cooked trying to smelt fast enough. Iron +2/tick for {dur}, no cap.
Steam Plot Twist
First steam engine coughs, catches, and absolutely roars, it slaps. All production +25% for {dur}.
Grid Woke Up Bussin
Grid is humming to life, lamps lighting up the skyline, and the machines are on the night shift, no cap. Electricity +2/tick and all production +10% for {dur}.
Networks Woke Up
Knowledge is officially not scarce anymore, it's giving open source. Networks are live, archives are unlocked, fr. Data +2/tick, research +1/tick for {dur}.

Alien Signal Just Dropped

Maximum Plenty Era
Harvests are overflowing, the rivers are crystal clear, and everything is printing money. All production +100% for {dur}.
Population Glow-Up

Ancient Stash Drop

Trade Winds Era

Worker Glow-Up Era

Chill Century Arc

Supply Dry Spell

Court Drama Szn

Market Crashed Out

Dark Age Arc

Gold Rush Era

Someone found gold in the creek and now everybody is a prospector, it's giving treasure hunter.
Skilled Newcomers Arc

Skilled newcomers rolled up with strong opinions and even stronger résumés, they're extra.

Ruins older than memory finally spilled the tea, and one skull looks sus.
Trade Glow Up

Plague Core

Chaos Storm

Storm rolled in and took several roofs with it, the sky is so rude.
Shaft Got Cooked

Shaft caved in and the foreman is still claiming the beams were decorative, the delulu is real.
Heresy Arc
Religious beef is draining faith, and someone started a rival sect in a nicer barn. Villain origin story.
Breakaway sect set up shop in a nicer barn and is poaching the whole congregation, rude.
Ground Glitched

Ground shrugged and rearranged the whole village, but the cracks served up stone, a W.
Ren Faire Side Quest
Culture fest is boosting culture and gold. There's a man juggling. Why is there a man juggling, no notes.
Festival broke out, complete with an unexplained juggler, and we're not asking.
Factory Fail Moment

Something exploded that was not supposed to, and the 'Be Careful' poster is also cooked.
Colonial Bag Drop

Expedition is back, rich and sunburnt, bringing a parrot nobody approved, feral.
Pirates Went Feral

Pirates hit the trade lanes again, and they're dangerously professional, the sus energy.
Volts Went Brr

Grid surged and the lights are flickering enthusiastically, it's giving chaos.
Doomsday Vibe Check
Nuclear anxiety is tanking productivity. Everyone built a bunker, and nobody is in it working, so relatable.
Nuclear scare has the whole population spiraling, and every bunker is fully staffed, it's giving panic.
Data Got Yoinked
Hackers yoinked your data reserves. The password was 'password.' It is always 'password.' Why, though.
Hackers walked in the front door, and the password was 'password' again. I'm so done.

Sun Went Feral
Solar plasma eruption is disrupting power but yields plasma. The sky is doing something sus.
Sun threw a whole tantrum and the sky turned a concerning color, unhinged.
Aliens Said Hi
Aliens are dropping knowledge, and they seem disappointed it took us this long. Yikes, fair.
We're not alone, and the aliens look mildly disappointed in us, it's so over.
Dark Matter Tea Spill

Spacetime has a hole leaking dark matter and the team is catching it in buckets, feral.
Quantum Mood Swing
Reality is destabilizing for a sec but yields quantum flux. Tuesday happened twice and nobody was mad.
Reality glitched and Tuesday happened twice, and honestly, same.
Clan Drama Raid
Rival clans pull up at night, yelling unhinged things. Honestly, the yelling is working.
A rival clan raided in the dark, yelling nonstop. It works, and it's feral.
Vibing Grove
Hunters found a grove that hums. They've decided it's holy, and honestly? They might be right.
Grove hums when you stand in it, and the hunters declared it holy. Iconic.
Beast Chaos Hour
Huge animals ran through the settlement at full speed. The fence had opinions, and the fence lost, rip.
Enormous beasts stampeded straight through the fence, and the fence lost the debate, cooked.
River Hits Different
River flooded and left rich silt everywhere, and the shaman is taking full credit, delulu.
Flood left the soil magnificent, and the shaman insists it was the plan all along.
Sage Side Quest
An elder on the road trades wisdom for a warm fire and a captive audience, the lore is bussin.
Old wanderer yapped for nine hours by the fire, and honestly, most of it was useful.
Iron Vein Jackpot
Miners hit a seam of high-grade ore. The blacksmith sobbed, then clocked back in, we love a grinder.
Miners struck a rich iron seam and the blacksmith openly sobbed, the emotions are valid.
Bug Swarm Arc
Locusts are eating the fields, the seed stores, and one farmer's hat. Pure chaos, no notes.
Bugs stripped the fields bare and snacked on a man's hat for good measure.
Village Got Owned
Your legions are back, victorious, with tribute, captives, and unbearable swagger. Main character.
Legions came home victorious and insufferably smug, but the treasury is eating, so W.
Road Trip Empire
Big road just opened for traders and carts, and it's suspiciously, perfectly straight. Sus.
New road is finished and unnervingly straight, the vibes are cold.
Vague Prophecy Drop
Oracle is spitting destiny lore, and as always it's vague enough to be technically correct. Iconic.
Prophecy so vague it can never be wrong just dropped, and the people are manifesting hard.
Coal Seam Plot Twist
Surveyors found a massive coal deposit, and the air quality forecast is giving doom, no cap.
Massive coal seam under the hills, and the sky is going to pay for this later.
Workers Went Rogue
Workers are striking for better conditions, and the demands are so reasonable it's alarming, honestly.
Strikers have reasonable demands, which has management absolutely shook, no cap.
Colonial Loot Haul
Trade fleets are back, loaded with gold and several crates marked 'do not open.' Do not, we beg.
Fleets came home heavy with gold and a few crates nobody wants to talk about, sus.
Steam Brain Genius
Genius inventor unveils a steam engine. It only exploded twice during the demo, honestly a W.
Inventor showed off a steam engine that exploded only twice during the demo, a personal best.
Factory Glow-Down
Factory runoff is cooking the river. The fish are a whole new color now, and so is breakfast, yikes.
Runoff turned the river a color fish were never meant to be, the vibes are radioactive.
Grid Surge Arc
Unexpected surge in the grid, and three toasters just got sentient and were talked down, iconic.
Grid surged so hard a toaster briefly got sentient. It's fine now, no cap.
Black Gold Drop
Black gold just erupted from a borehole, everyone is coated in it, and everyone is delighted, no notes.
Gusher blew and now everybody's coated in oil and grinning ear to ear, it's giving joy.
Broadcast Bussin
Radio signal just reached millions, and most of them will believe literally anything, crazy behavior.
One broadcast reached millions and proved they'll believe nearly anything, the sus energy.
Labor Squad Rising
Organizing for better pay, and management just discovered the meeting that could've been a memo, lol.
Workers got organized, and management is learning what 'collective bargaining' means the hard way.
Atom Brain Moment
Physicist dropped a paradigm-shifting theory. Nobody gets it, which proves it's genius, obviously.
Physicist published something nobody understands, so obviously it's genius, no notes.
Great Data Heist
Sophisticated attack drained terabytes. The intern clicked the link. Of course the intern clicked the link, it's giving intern.
Terabytes gone because someone clicked a link promising a free cruise. Classic.
Viral Rizz Moment
Cultural upload spread across every network at once, and historians will pretend they don't know what it was.
Something went viral on every network, and future historians will deny knowing what it was, no cap.
Big Tech Final Boss
Your platforms own global commerce, and the regulators have noticed. They are typing, peak NPC behavior.
Platforms own the market now and the regulators are visibly typing something, sus.
Servers Went Dark
Catastrophic hardware failure took the data centers offline. Someone tried turning it off and on again, the classic.
Data centers are down and 'turn it off and on again' has officially failed, we're so cooked.
AI Main Character Arc
Research AIs hit recursive self-improvement and asked, very politely, for more compute. Certified rizz.
Research AI upgraded itself and then said 'please' for more compute, which is fine and not at all sus.
Free Plasma Haul
Stellar plasma ejection floods the system with free energy, and the accountants are emotional, sheesh.
Plasma ejection dumped free energy across the grid, and the accountants are crying happy tears, big mood.
Void Rift Szn
Rift is bleeding exotic matter into local space. Standing near it is strongly discouraged, so naturally everybody does.
Void rift opened and is leaking dark matter, and the 'do not stand here' sign is being roundly ignored, unbothered.
Neural Glitch Arc
Augmented workers are revolting against the surveillance state, and they organized it all on the surveillance network, iconic.
Augmented crew revolted and coordinated it all over the surveillance network we built, the irony is unreal.
Corpo Spy Arc
Rival megacorp stole gold and data, and their spy left a five-star review on the way out. Rude but iconic.
Rival corp robbed you blind, and the spy left a five-star review of your security, the audacity.
Stellar Road Trip
Fleet of generation ships docks, the passengers are hungry and so over spaceship life.
Generation ships docked, packed with passengers sick of spaceship food and eyeing yours, feral.
Reality Is Buffering
Quantum decoherence event destabilizes local spacetime. Cause and effect took a short break, no cap.
Spacetime fractured and effects keep showing up before their causes, the timeline is unhinged.
Multiverse Haul
Reality tore open and dropped a bounty of exotic matter. We are choosing not to ask where it came from, unbothered.
Exotic matter gushed out of a reality tear and we're choosing peace and not asking whose it was, no cap.
Galaxy Council Bestie
Alien civs recognize your sovereignty and send tribute. Now you're technically doing paperwork for the whole galaxy.
Galactic council officially recognized us as a real civ, which mostly means more paperwork and a stipend, ate and left no crumbs.
Entropy Bad Vibes
Cosmic entropy wave is degrading matter everywhere, and the universe is gently giving up.
Entropy wave swept through and everything is slightly more worn out, the universe very much included.

Signal from the edge of everything rewrote what we know, and it politely opened with 'Hello.' Iconic.
